spatial_reference: Stage1 start_node (OSM node ID) + frozen PBF WGS84
current_position_assignment: nearest positive-demand node in current Train TOD bin
integer_quota_rule: deterministic largest remainder; fractional remainder descending then node_id string ascending
surplus_vehicle_rule: vehicle_id ascending; retain the first target quota at each current node
deficit_matching_rule: nearest geographic deficit with remaining quota; squared local lon/lat distance then node_id
routing: existing Valhalla sparse matrix adapter grouped by destination with frozen single-route fallback
failed_route_action: stay at current location and remain idle
